svg.title: Lord of Sorrow: Three of Swords · Saturn in Libra · Binah (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Saturn above the painting and Libra below, as Book T places them: "Above and below the central sword are the symbols of Saturn and Libra." Its ring: number 28 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1795880531764-4ncpk6q294o.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
